lens: routing: return paths and EMI across the whole board (round 23 angle)

findings.title: R10's bench gates have no GNSS self-interference check, although the 25 MHz HSE's 63rd harmonic (1575.000 MHz) lies 0.42 MHz from GPS L1, inside the C/A main lobe

evidence.board: Y1 value '25MHz CL8pF', B(22.85,46.6), on m3.kicad_pcb 5516eeec; its HSE_IN / HSE_OUT run over the In2 Y1 GND island (R10_GND_In2_Y1, 37.2 mm^2, 8 GND vias)
evidence.arithmetic: 25.000 MHz x 63 = 1575.000 MHz; GPS L1 = 1575.42 MHz; offset 0.42 MHz < 1.023 MHz (C/A chipping rate, the half-width of the main lobe). Firmware clocks with the same property (Inference): 25 MHz x 63 and 75 MHz x 21 = 1575.000 MHz, e.g. an SPI3 / QSPI SCK at 25 or 75 MHz
evidence.receiver: docs/REQUIREMENTS.md F10: HGLRC M100 Mini external GPS (u-blox M10, L1 only) on DB125 J410 F(38.6,15.5), powered from PORT_4V8 whenever the battery path is on; its harness carries PORT_4V8, GND and the two 1 kOhm UART lines from the board into the bay
evidence.records: docs/ORDERING.md line 167 (section 5, the R9 board) records this exact harmonic ('25 MHz x 63 = 1575.000 MHz, 0.42 MHz from L1') and prescribes UBX-NAV-SIG C/N0 and UBX-MON-SPAN captures. The R10 section 8.3 (line 572) inherits only 'section 5's generic static, leakage, reset, bootloader, power-transition, thermal and sensor tests'. A search of the R10 sections of ORDERING.md, R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF.md, M3_R10.md, REQUIREMENTS.md and R10_VALIDATION.md for C/N0, MON-SPAN, coexist, desense and harmonic finds no R10 GNSS check. F10's 'installed full-power RF immunity' is the radio-into-pyro test, not the board-into-GPS test
evidence.standard: IS-GPS-200 (https://www.gps.gov/technical/icwg/IS-GPS-200N.pdf), section 3.3.1.1 (L1 carrier 1575.42 MHz) and section 3.2.1.3 (C/A code 1.023 Mbps); sections cited, page numbers not checked

findings.impact: The spur level is unknown (Inference). A steady in-band spur conducted on the J410 harness or radiated into the module's patch antenna can lower C/N0 or stop the fix. That costs tracking and recovery data only: the GPS is not a flight-control or pyro input. No on-board copper is wrong; this is an evidence gap that R9 closed and R10 dropped when the RF left the board.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only. (1) ORDERING 8.3: add an installed GNSS self-interference check. Put the GPS on its flight harness in the bay, then log UBX-NAV-SIG C/N0 and UBX-MON-SPAN (max hold, where the module's firmware supports it) in two conditions. First, the GPS is powered from a bench supply with the board unpowered. Second, the board runs at its flight clock, writing the QSPI and SD logs, with the camera on and the servos stepping. Record any peak at 1575.000 MHz or elsewhere in the L1 band, and the C/N0 change. (2) M3_R10 'Firmware': avoid SPI3, QSPI and timer clocks that have an integer harmonic within +/-1.023 MHz of 1575.42 MHz (25 and 75 MHz are examples). Label this an Inference until (1) has run.

rejected_or_closed_candidates.topic: Plane splits, slots or voids under fast or critical nets
rejected_or_closed_candidates.result: None. Every track sample (0.1 mm step) of QSPI_*, SD_*, SPI1_*, IMU_CS / INT1, USB_DP / DM, HSE_IN / OUT, the GPS / RADIO / AUX / CAM UART nets and SERVO*_MCU / OUT lies over adjacent reference copper, except inside its own via antipad (0.6 mm). F.Cu runs over In1 GND, which is one piece with antipads only (3723.6 mm^2). B.Cu runs over one In2 net per run: SD_* over 3V3 (30.0-30.8 mm each), HSE over the Y1 GND island, GPS / RADIO wire nets over PORT_4V8, CAM and AUX over 3V3, SERVO*_OUT over RAW_PROTECTED. The radius probe puts every trace edge at least 0.0-0.1 mm inside its reference copper; the near-zero margins are grazes of neighbouring via antipads inside U1's fan-out. No via fences exist (no on-board RF).

rejected_or_closed_candidates.topic: Fire-path loop (BAT_IN -> Q120 -> Q121 -> RAW_ACT -> R134 -> J121.2 -> e-match -> J121.1 -> Q124 -> GND -> J1.2)
rejected_or_closed_candidates.result: Not filed. The on-board centre-line loop encloses 85.7-90.0 mm^2 in absolute area (two lobes; net 18.4 to -28.4 mm^2), for a return straight from Q124's source to J1.2 or along x 9. The external e-match leads add their own area. Nearest fire copper: IMU U4.8 8.81 mm (PYRO1_OUT F.Cu); Y1.4 10.52 mm (RAW_ACT B.Cu); U5.8 2.93 mm (PYRO1_OUT F.Cu over In1 GND, U5 on the bottom); U1.1 6.13 mm. Biot-Savart Bz per amp at mid-board: U5 7.2, U4 1.6, Y1 0.81, U1 0.50 uT/A, so at most 9.2 / 2.1 uT at the 1.279 A four-stall case. The baro and IMU have no magnetometer. Q124's gate is slowed by R126 220 Ohm and C126 220 nF (tau 48 us), so the turn-on dI/dt is about 1e4-1e5 A/s (Inference). EMF in a 3 mm^2 crystal loop is about 0.2 uV. PYRO1_OUT comes no closer than 1.63 mm (XY) to I2C1_SDA and 3.55 mm to I2C1_SCL. Evidence: p11_fireloop.json, p12_loop_area.json

rejected_or_closed_candidates.topic: Coupling between the servo outputs and the IMU / baro lines
rejected_or_closed_candidates.result: Not filed. SERVO*_MCU leave U1's south pins (27.5-29.0, 50.55) and run south-east on F.Cu at x 30.3-31.74. No servo copper is within 8 mm (XY, any layer) of SPI1_*, IMU_*, I2C1_* or BARO_SDO; the nearest clock is HSE_OUT, 4.3 mm. Under the 1 kOhm R150-R153 at x 34.6 the reference changes from 3V3 to RAW_PROTECTED. The 1 kOhm bounds that return current to 3.3 mA at PWM rates. D121's GND pin reaches GND via (31.5,73.6) by a 0.95 mm, 0.3 mm track, and its pin 5 sits on 3V3 with the internal TVS clamping the rail (Semtech SRV05-4 datasheet Rev 08/11/04 p.4: pin 2 'connected directly to a ground plane'; pin 5 to VCC, 'the internal TVS diode prevents over-voltage on the supply rail'). The nearest 3V3-GND capacitor is 9.43 mm away (C8), which needs no bypass by that text.

rejected_or_closed_candidates.topic: In2 islands under U400, L400 and U401
rejected_or_closed_candidates.result: Not filed (planned in D-R2-03 / D-R2-05; tab row 28). U400 F(16.9,5.55) sits over In2 RAW_PROTECTED, its own input. L400's body straddles the RAW / PORT_5V3 gap (x 24.2-24.5); In1 GND, 0.203 mm under F.Cu, shields the SW node from In2. U401 B(27.6,13.6) straddles the PORT_5V3 / PORT_4V8 boundary at x 28.0-28.3. Every In2 zone is one piece. The forward RAW region reaches U400 only through the east-edge strip x 44.0-45.5 (1.5 mm wide, about 58 mm long). Calculation: 0.573 mOhm/sq at 30 um, about 22 mOhm, about 29 mV at an inferred 1.3 A input. Its HF return is the B.Cu GND pour 0.203 mm below. The rail is input-decoupled by C400 / C401 at U400. PORT_5V3 east strip x 41.0-43.7 has a 1.12 mm local neck at U402's feed vias; PORT_4V8 is at least 1.31 mm. The 3V3 finger from U2 (x 22.0-23.7) has 0.40-0.55 mm necks between via antipads, as recorded (K-plane 0.549 mm). Hot loops: U400-C401 about 7.6 mm^2 on F.Cu over In1 GND, GND via 0.85 mm from U400.4; U2-C6 about 4 mm^2 on B.Cu over In2 RAW.

rejected_or_closed_candidates.topic: Edge stitching of the outer GND pours
rejected_or_closed_candidates.result: Not filed. Within 3 mm of the edge the largest gap between GND stitches is 50 mm on the east edge, between (43.5,8.0) and (43.6,58.0). But J410.2, J420.2, J9.2 and J122.5 at x 38.6 (16 mm pitch) and the vias at x 36-37 tie the F.Cu / B.Cu pours to In1 7 mm from the edge. The worst pour point, (45.25,78.25), is 12.2 mm from a stitch. The longest unstitched span is about 22 mm (y 65-87), whose half-wave resonance in FR4 is about 3.2 GHz, above L1 (Inference). The west and forward edges are within 3 mm; the aft edge is within 4-8 mm.

Not filed. NRST runs 5.74 mm beside HSE_OUT at 0.30 mm on F.Cu inside U1's pad ring, over In1 GND. That is about 0.3 pF of coupling (Inference) into a reset node held by its capacitor; the effect on the crystal is a fraction of CL 8 pF. Other foreign copper is at least 0.25 mm away and has no parallel run. Y1 sits on its own In2 GND island, as in AVA section 6 item 5. The recorded NRST projection over Y1 (0.778 mm, In1 between) is unchanged.

rejected_or_closed_candidates.result: Recorded (AUD-2 slow-return observations; R18-m05). The 63.6 mm In2 USB_LIMITED track and the 3V3A track slot the 3V3 fill. coverage_limits: Geometry and first-order calculation only: no field solver, SI, EMI or ESD simulation, and no measurement. Return paths are inferred from adjacent-plane geometry, not solved current distributions.
Biot-Savart uses centre-lines in the board plane with a straight or x = 9 return; plane eddy currents and the harness loop are not modelled.
Neck widths come from a 0.05 mm raster with a chamfer distance transform (about +/-0.1 mm) and from polygon deflation near vias; seed regions near via antipads limit the reported bottleneck locally.
The 'nearest bridging capacitor' search counts two-pad GND / ring-net capacitors only, not U1's VDD / VSS pin pairs or plane capacitance.
AVA comparison: AVA_LAYOUT.md is a visual placement reference and its images show no inner layers, so AVA's return-plane practice cannot be compared beyond that record's section 6 items.
The full tools/check.sh and full check_r10 were not run (brief). DRC ran on a probe copy without schematic parity.
IS-GPS-200 page numbers not checked; the spur level at 1575.000 MHz and the HGLRC module's MON-SPAN support are unverified (Inference).
